description: This file defines the RpcEnv class and related components for Spark's RPC system, including factory methods, endpoint management, and file server interfaces.

classes.name: RpcEnv
classes.description: An abstract class representing the RPC environment in Spark, managing endpoints, communication, and file serving.

classes.name: RpcEnvFileServer
classes.description: A trait defining the interface for a file server used by RpcEnv to serve files to other processes.

classes.name: RpcEnvConfig
classes.description: A case class holding configuration parameters for RpcEnv.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods to create RpcEnv instances with specified parameters.

methods.name: endpointRef
methods.description: Returns the RpcEndpointRef of a registered RpcEndpoint.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns the address that RpcEnv is listening to.

methods.name: setupEndpoint
methods.description: Registers an RpcEndpoint with a name and returns its reference.

methods.name: asyncSetupEndpointRefByURI
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an RpcEndpointRef given a URI.

methods.name: setupEndpointRefByURI
methods.description: Retrieves an RpcEndpointRef given a URI, blocking until available.

methods.name: setupEndpointRef
methods.description: Retrieves an RpcEndpointRef given an address and endpoint name, blocking until available.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Waits for the RpcEnv to exit.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes objects containing RpcEndpointRef, wrapping the deserialization process.

methods.name: fileServer
methods.description: Returns the RpcEnvFileServer used by this RpcEnv.

methods.name: openChannel
methods.description: Opens a channel to download a file from a given URI.
